prompt: Create a Python 3.12 application for managing books. Users can create, list, update and delete books. Users must also be able to search books by title. Persist the books in SQLite.

intentions.text: I can create a new book in the library system.
intentions.requires: a book title, author, ISBN, publication year, genre
intentions.observable: The book is added to the list of books and persists in the database.

intentions.text: I can list all books currently in the library system.
intentions.observable: A list of all books is displayed, showing title, author, ISBN, publication year, genre.

intentions.text: I can update the details of an existing book.
intentions.requires: a book title (to identify), new title, author, ISBN, publication year, genre
intentions.observable: The book's details are updated and the updated list reflects the change.

intentions.text: I can delete a book from the library system.
intentions.observable: The book is removed from the list and the database is updated.

intentions.text: I can search for books by title.
intentions.observable: A list of books matching the title is displayed.
